documents.title: User stories — PM job (T3)
documents.body:
# User stories — PM job (T3)

## Personas

- **The PM job** — the tenant's project-manager role, bound as a job; it runs a request end to end.
- **The delivery lead** — raises the request the PM job charters, plans and baselines.
- **The gate approver** — a distinct human principal who decides the gates the PM requested or executed.
- **The PMO lead** — keeps the project register, the approved baselines and the change-control record.
- **The architecture board** — approves the typed architecture contract a gate accepts as evidence.
- **The downstream project leads** — T4, T9, T10, T11, T17 and T12 consume the governed project rows this job produces.

## Stories

- As the PM job, I want to turn a request into a chartered, planned and baselined project in one run, so that the delivery is governed from its first gate.
- As the PM job, I want to route each gate in order and close a project only after its closure gate is approved, so that closure is an approved act, not an assertion.
- As the delivery lead, I want a non-PM job refused when it tries to create or close a project, so that the register keeps one accountable owner per project.
- As the gate approver, I want the PM refused as an approver of a gate it requested or executed, so that no gate judges its own work.
- As the PMO lead, I want an approved baseline to advance only through an approved change request that records its impact, so that the baseline stays the contract.
- As the architecture board, I want a gate's typed evidence, an approved architecture contract, resolved against the live row, so that draft or superseded evidence cannot pass.

## Scenarios

@verify=T3.1
Scenario: A PM job charters, plans and baselines a request in one run
Given a tenant with the PM job bound and a request from a delivery lead
When the PM job runs the request
Then a project exists with a charter approval, a WBS and a recorded baseline, and the run ends with evidence

@verify=T3.2
Scenario: A project closes only after its closure gate is approved
Given a baselined project staffed by job bindings
When its gates resolve in order
Then the PM routes the next gate and closes the project only after the closure gate is approved

@verify=T3.3
Scenario: Only a PM job creates and closes projects
Given a non-PM job in the same tenant
When it attempts to create or close a project
Then the request is refused and no project row changes

@verify=T3.4
Scenario: The PM cannot decide its own gate
Given a gate the PM requested
When the PM records an approving decision
Then the action returns a typed refusal and writes no approval_decision row

@verify=T3.5
Scenario: A distinct approver's decision is recorded
Given the same gate the PM requested
When a different human records an approving decision
Then the decision is recorded, so the gate remains fail-able

@verify=T3.6
Scenario: A new baseline without a change request is refused
Given an approved baseline
When the PM writes a new baseline version without a change request
Then the write is refused and the approved baseline row is unchanged

@verify=T3.7
Scenario: An approved change request advances the baseline
Given an approved baseline and a change request carrying its impact block
When a second principal approves the change request
Then the baseline advances to a new version and the two records cite each other

@verify=T3.8
Scenario: A live approved contract resolves the gate
Given a gate whose required evidence is a live approved architecture contract
When the PM routes the gate
Then the gate resolves and a trace link from the contract to the project exists

@verify=T3.9
Scenario: A draft or superseded contract refuses the gate
Given a contract that is draft or superseded
When the gate is requested
Then it is refused naming the contract's state and no approval row is written

@verify=T3.10
Scenario: A gate without an evidence reference is refused
Given a gate with no evidence reference
When it is requested
Then it is refused gate_evidence_missing

## Verify

- T3.1 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_lifecycle the_pm_charters_plans_and_baselines_a_request`
- T3.2 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_close_gate a_project_closes_only_after_the_closure_gate`
- T3.3 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_lifecycle only_pm_creates_and_closes`
- T3.4 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_self_approval the_pm_cannot_decide_its_own_gate`
- T3.5 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_self_approval a_distinct_approver_is_recorded`
- T3.6 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_baseline_change a_new_baseline_without_a_change_request_is_refused`
- T3.7 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_baseline_change approved_change_request_advances_the_baseline`
- T3.8 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_gate_evidence a_live_contract_resolves_the_gate`
- T3.9 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_gate_evidence a_draft_contract_refuses_the_gate`
- T3.10 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_gate_evidence a_gate_without_evidence_is_refused`
- Supporting — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test registry`; `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test parity_http_mcp`

## Links

- Spec: `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §6.1 (charter, outputs, never, gates), §12 T3 row, §5.4 (dual control), §8.1 (the architecture contract as a gate object).
- Decision: `docs/decisions/0005-absorption-sequence-and-repo-scope.md` decision 1.
- Issue: #74 (T3 — PM job), `CLOSED`; lane `issue/74-pm-job`; evidence head `44cc7b6`.
- Seed: `seed/programme.json` `projects[T3].meta`; audit row `actions:PM`.

# Acceptance criteria — PM job (T3)

## Scenarios

- @verify=T3.1 — A PM job turns a request into a project with a charter approval, a WBS and a recorded baseline, and the run ends with evidence.
- @verify=T3.2 — A baselined project's gates resolve in order; the PM closes it only after the closure gate is approved.
- @verify=T3.3 — A non-PM job is refused when it attempts to create or close a project, and no project row changes.
- @verify=T3.4 — The PM's approving decision on a gate it requested is refused and writes no `approval_decision` row.
- @verify=T3.5 — A distinct human's approving decision on the same gate is recorded.
- @verify=T3.6 — A new baseline version written without a change request is refused and the approved baseline row is unchanged.
- @verify=T3.7 — An approved change request advances the baseline to a new version and the two records cite each other.
- @verify=T3.8 — A gate whose required evidence is a live approved architecture contract resolves, and a trace link exists from the contract to the project.
- @verify=T3.9 — A draft or superseded contract refuses the gate naming its state, with no approval row written.
- @verify=T3.10 — A gate with no evidence reference is refused `gate_evidence_missing`.

## Verify commands

- T3.1 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_lifecycle the_pm_charters_plans_and_baselines_a_request`
- T3.2 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_close_gate a_project_closes_only_after_the_closure_gate`
- T3.3 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_lifecycle only_pm_creates_and_closes`
- T3.4 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_self_approval the_pm_cannot_decide_its_own_gate`
- T3.5 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_self_approval a_distinct_approver_is_recorded`
- T3.6 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_baseline_change a_new_baseline_without_a_change_request_is_refused`
- T3.7 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_baseline_change approved_change_request_advances_the_baseline`
- T3.8 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_gate_evidence a_live_contract_resolves_the_gate`
- T3.9 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_gate_evidence a_draft_contract_refuses_the_gate`
- T3.10 — `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_gate_evidence a_gate_without_evidence_is_refused`

## Results

Met at the recorded head `44cc7b6`. #74's Evidence at completion table records all ten scenario tests pass: `pm_lifecycle` 5/5 binary, `pm_close_gate` 4/4 binary, `pm_self_approval` with a 409 conflict and no decision row plus a recorded distinct approver, `pm_baseline_change` with a 409 `change_request_required` plus an approved change request advancing the baseline with mutual citation, and `pm_gate_evidence` with a trace edge plus 422 `gate_evidence_not_live` and 422 `gate_evidence_missing`. The supporting gates passed at the same head: `conveyor-actions` registry 407 actions with a matching dump, and `parity_http_mcp` 7/7 with six new samples.

The issue records these through the historical `rbuild --` wrapper. `rbuild` is retired, so the commands above are the same tests invoked directly; the compile answer is the repository's preflight and the PR's CI.

## Status

met — all ten scenarios pass at the recorded head and #74 is `CLOSED`. Qualification: the issue body's DoR and DoD checkboxes were not ticked; its filled Evidence at completion table is the evidence this document rests on.

## Links

- Spec: `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §6.1, §12 T3 row, §5.4, §8.1.
- Issue: #74, `CLOSED`; evidence head `44cc7b6`; lane `issue/74-pm-job`.
- Seed: `seed/programme.json` `projects[T3].meta`; audit row `actions:PM`.

# Definition of ready — PM job (T3)

## Independent

T3 sits after T2 and before T4, T9, T10, T11, T17 and T12. At claim the baseline was re-measured on `main@9d75dc3` (2026-11-17) after T2's decision ladder merged (`39363ba`, 2026-11-17). The four parts share the V1 approval primitive (`migrations/0002_domain.sql`, `crates/actions/src/control/approvals.rs`) and the API test tree, so the unit is one lane rather than four; the issue's DoR requires a one-PR scope, file-disjoint from other ready issues or explicitly sequenced.

## Negotiable

The outcome is fixed by §6.1's Charter/Outputs/Never/Gates and §12's T3 row — "PM runs a request end to end; cannot approve its own gate; a baseline change requires a change request". The implementation stayed negotiable: three open questions carried defaults — the self-approval refusal at the domain layer for every gate, staffing as a `job_binding` write, and append-only baseline versions — and no contrary decision is recorded in #74.

## Valuable

It removes the named gap: at claim, `docs/evidence/v2-coverage.md` row `actions:PM` read `new`, and no `pm.` action existed in `crates/actions/src`. It unblocks #75 (T4), #81 (T9), #82 (T10), #84 (T11, whose gate recomputes metrics from the run and approval rows T3 produces), #87 (T17) and #88 (T12).

## Estimable

The issue names the baseline (`main@5cf3d75`, measured 2026-11-13; re-measured `main@9d75dc3`), the document blob shas, the reused approval primitive and each test file to create. Every part P1–P4 carried at least one scenario with a `Verify:` command or test target.

## Small

One issue #74, one lane `issue/74-pm-job`, one PR; four parts (P1–P4) inside the API and actions crates of one service. The issue records "no live scenario, so there is no deployment gate to wait on".

## Testable

Ten scenarios across five test binaries, each with a command: `pm_lifecycle`, `pm_close_gate`, `pm_self_approval`, `pm_baseline_change`, `pm_gate_evidence`, plus the `registry` and `parity_http_mcp` tests. The refusals are typed and observable — 409 for self-approval and for a missing change request, 422 `gate_evidence_not_live` and 422 `gate_evidence_missing`.

## Dependencies

| Relation | Issue | Why | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| blocked-by | #73 (T2) | `seed/programme.json` T3 `meta.depends_on` = `["T2"]`; SPEC §12 "T0 → T1 → T2 → T3" | closed 2026-11-17, merged `39363ba` |
| related | #46 | ADR 0005's queue superseded by the 2026-11-16 amendment (#243, merged `59e2e04`) | open |
| blocks | #75 (T4) | T4 `meta.depends_on` = `["T3"]`; SPEC §12 "T4 after T3" | open |
| blocks | #81 (T9) | T9 `meta.depends_on` = `["T1","T3"]` | open |
| blocks | #82 (T10) | T10 `meta.depends_on` = `["T1","T3"]` | open |
| blocks | #84 (T11) | the T11 gate recomputes metrics from the run and approval rows T3 produces | open |
| blocks | #87 (T17) | T17 `meta.depends_on` = `["T16","T3"]` | open |
| blocks | #88 (T12) | T12 `meta.depends_on` lists T3; SPEC §12 "T12 after all" | open |

## Links

- Spec: `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §6.1, §12 T3 row and dependency line, §5.4.
- Issue: #74 (T3 — PM job), `CLOSED`; claim HEAD `2cd53a8`; evidence head `44cc7b6`.
- Seed: `seed/programme.json` `projects[T3].meta`; audit row `actions:PM`.

# Definition of done — PM job (T3)

## Acceptance criteria

| Scenario | Evidence | Verify |
|---|---|---|
| T3.1 — A PM job charters, plans and baselines a request in one run | pass at `44cc7b6`, 5/5 binary | `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_lifecycle the_pm_charters_plans_and_baselines_a_request` |
| T3.2 — A project closes only after its closure gate is approved | pass at `44cc7b6`, 4/4 binary | `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_close_gate a_project_closes_only_after_the_closure_gate` |
| T3.3 — Only a PM job creates and closes projects | pass at `44cc7b6` | `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_lifecycle only_pm_creates_and_closes` |
| T3.4 — The PM cannot decide its own gate | pass at `44cc7b6`, 409 conflict and no decision row | `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_self_approval the_pm_cannot_decide_its_own_gate` |
| T3.5 — A distinct approver's decision is recorded | pass at `44cc7b6` | `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_self_approval a_distinct_approver_is_recorded` |
| T3.6 — A new baseline without a change request is refused | pass at `44cc7b6`, 409 `change_request_required` | `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_baseline_change a_new_baseline_without_a_change_request_is_refused` |
| T3.7 — An approved change request advances the baseline | pass at `44cc7b6`, mutual citation | `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_baseline_change approved_change_request_advances_the_baseline` |
| T3.8 — A live approved contract resolves the gate | pass at `44cc7b6`, trace edge | `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_gate_evidence a_live_contract_resolves_the_gate` |
| T3.9 — A draft or superseded contract refuses the gate | pass at `44cc7b6`, 422 `gate_evidence_not_live` | `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_gate_evidence a_draft_contract_refuses_the_gate` |
| T3.10 — A gate without an evidence reference is refused | pass at `44cc7b6`, 422 `gate_evidence_missing` | `cargo test -p conveyor-api --test pm_gate_evidence a_gate_without_evidence_is_refused` |

## Evidence at completion

#74's Evidence at completion table is filled at `44cc7b6`: all ten scenario rows pass, and the supporting rows pass too — `conveyor-actions` registry 407 actions with a matching dump, and `parity_http_mcp` 7/7 with six new samples. The issue is `CLOSED`. The issue body's DoR and DoD checkboxes were left unticked; the filled evidence table, not the checklist, is the record. The recorded commands use the retired `rbuild --` wrapper; the table above names the same tests directly.

## Repo gate

At the time the unit's gate was `rbuild --gate`. That route is retired: the equivalent gate now is the repository's GitHub-hosted `preflight.yml` and the PR's CI, green at the PR head, with the non-compiling local hooks (`cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo metadata --locked`, actionlint) on commit and push. The unit's DoD also requires migrations/ledger and `--check-lock` handling when a migration is touched.

## Merge and closure

The lane `issue/74-pm-job` carried the unit to its one PR with `Closes #74`; #74 is `CLOSED`, which is the closure fact read for this document, and `44cc7b6` is the tested revision it records. T4, T9, T10, T11, T17 and T12 were unblocked and remain open as their own units, per the dependency table in #74.
